answer: A stake-weighted reputation ledger makes fake identities expensive: each agent locks collateral that is slashed when its attestations prove false, so spawning a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes. Like an orchard where every tree is planted with a deposit, or a meadow where each plot is tended by one gardener, an opal only shines after repeated verifiable work — a Sybil farmer must fund and tend every fake plot, and the cost grows faster than the reward.
